items.title: Pete Barbutti interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, December 8, 2022
items.q: And he looked over at me and he saw me, and the two of us just broke up, it was like futile.

ctx.x: Don’t you just love the noisemakers?

Yeah, right. One of the things burned in my mind is, again it was New Year’s Eve at the Sahara and David Brenner, rest his soul he was a good guy, David was on stage in the showroom. And so I went back and stood in the wings and looked and David was doing his act and there were a thousand people in the room, that’s absolute capacity. And not one of them was watching the stage or listening to anything he was saying. They were all yelling and screaming. And he looked over at me and he saw me, and the two of us just…
Yeah, sometimes reality is funnier than intended comedy I guess.
